# Radiance Med Spa

> Physician-overseen medical spa in Chambersburg, PA offering injectables, laser and RF treatments, facials, IV therapy, weight loss, and medical-grade skincare.

Radiance Med Spa provides medically supervised aesthetic care with an emphasis on natural, refined results. Treatments are delivered by licensed providers under physician oversight.

## Booking & Availability

- By appointment only.
- Treatments other than neurotoxin and dermal filler are unavailable until renovation is complete in November/December 2026.
- A provider consultation ($50, fully credited toward any service booked at or after the visit) is required prior to any treatment.
- Cancellation policy (all appointments): Cancel or reschedule at least 48 hours in advance. Cancellations made less than 48 hours before an appointment incur a $50 fee.

## VIP Membership

Your monthly VIP payment is banked as a service credit for future eligible treatments. All plans have an initial 6-month commitment, then renew month to month. VIP discounts on eligible services and injectables apply automatically at checkout. Retail benefits vary by tier — ask our team for details.

Founder VIP offer: The first 50 VIPs receive an additional discount. Ask the Radiance team for details.

### Glow — $99/month (Essential)
- 5% off eligible services & injectables — applied automatically at every visit
- 1 facial or chemical peel per quarter
- Birthday month: complimentary LED upgrade
- Quarterly facial or peel must be redeemed within the calendar quarter in which it is issued; it does not roll over
- Best for: skincare-focused clients building a maintenance routine

### Luminary — $199/month (Most Popular)
- Everything in Glow, plus:
- 10% off eligible services & injectables — supersedes Glow discount
- 1 complimentary booster add-on per quarter
- Birthday month: complimentary LED upgrade + complimentary Glacé facial ($200 value)
- Best for: clients combining injectables with skin treatments

### Radiant — $349/month (Prestige)
- Everything in Luminary, plus:
- 15% off eligible services & injectables — supersedes Luminary discount
- 2 complimentary booster add-ons per quarter
- Birthday month: complimentary LED upgrade + Glacé facial + $100 service credit + complimentary IV drip
- First access to new services & limited promotions
- Best for: full-service aesthetic clients who visit 2–3x per month

### VIP program terms (effective September 27, 2026)

- Eligibility and billing: Adults 18+ only. Enrollment starts with a signed agreement and first payment. Monthly dues are billed on the enrollment date or the next business day when that date falls on a weekend or holiday. Initial 6-month commitment; thereafter month-to-month auto-renewal. After two consecutive failed payments benefits are suspended; an account unresolved 15 days after initial decline may be cancelled. Price changes require 30 days' email notice; a VIP may cancel without penalty within 15 days of the adjustment notice.
- Banked service credits: Each monthly payment becomes a credit for eligible treatments. Unused credits roll over indefinitely while active and remain usable for 12 months after cancellation, then expire. They may be used for weight management and peptide programs at full price. Credits are non-transferable and have no cash value except as provided by the early-cancellation refund below.
- Included perks: Complimentary quarterly perks, including the quarterly facial/peel and boosters, must be redeemed within the calendar quarter in which they are issued. They expire at quarter's end and do not roll over. Birth month perks must be redeemed during the VIP's birth month and expire at the end of that month. All unused perks are forfeited immediately upon cancellation; they are separate from banked credits and cannot be exchanged, transferred, or redeemed for cash or credit.
- Discounts: Automatically applied at checkout on eligible services and injectables only. Not combinable with promotions or sale prices; not retroactive; not applicable to weight management or peptide programs. All VIP tiers receive package pricing at 20% off the regular single-session total; tier discounts don't stack on top. Retail benefits vary by tier — ask the team.
- Cancellation: May be requested at any time without penalty with 30 days' written notice to contact@radiancepa.com or in person. If notice is less than 30 days before the next billing date, one additional billing cycle applies. Credits remain usable for 12 months after cancellation; included perks end immediately.
- Refunds: Within the first 6 months, eligible for a refund of unused funds, calculated as dues paid less funds used toward services and treatments at VIP pricing and the standard non-VIP value of included perks used. Refunds go to the original payment method within 10 business days of effective cancellation. After 6 months, monthly dues are non-refundable, but banked credits remain usable for 12 months after cancellation. Billing errors are credited or refunded within 10 business days of confirmation.
- Changes and pauses: Upgrades or downgrades take effect next billing cycle. One pause of up to 60 days per 12 months is available for qualifying medical, relocation, or extended travel reasons with written request at least 5 business days before billing; no charges or credits accrue and benefits are suspended during the pause.
- Appointments: Cancel or reschedule at least 48 hours in advance; late cancellations or no-shows may incur up to a $50 fee, not taken from credits. Three no-shows within 12 months may require prepayment for future bookings. Luminary and Radiant VIPs get priority access to select high-demand slots 48 hours before general availability. Treatment requires consultation and provider approval. If Radiance cancels a treatment, any used credit is restored.
- Conduct, privacy and amendments: Radiance Med Spa may cancel a VIP plan for abuse of policy, chargebacks, or conduct inconsistent with the spa's code of conduct, with written notice. VIP information is handled per the spa's privacy policy and applicable Pennsylvania and federal regulations, including HIPAA, and is not sold or shared for third-party marketing without written consent. The policy may be amended with at least 30 days' email notice; continued participation after the effective date constitutes acceptance.

# Treatments & Pricing

## Injectables

### Consultation
- Provider Consultation: $50 — $50 fully credited toward any service booked at or after your visit

### Neurotoxin
- Botox — Per Unit: $14 / unit — Priced per unit; units vary by area and individual
- Jeuveau — Per Unit: $12 / unit — Priced per unit; units vary by area and individual
- Dysport — Per Unit: $5 / unit — Requires more units than Botox; comparable results

### Dermal Filler
- Dermal Filler: Starting at $550 / syringe — Pricing varies by product and volume
- Lips — Typical: 1–2 syringes
- Cheeks / Midface — Typical: 2–4 syringes
- Jawline / Chin — Typical: 2–4 syringes
- Nasolabial Folds / Marionette Lines — Typical: 1–2 syringes
- Tear Trough / Under Eye — Typical: 1–2 syringes; highly technical area

### Biostimulators
- Sculptra: $900 / vial — Per vial; most protocols use 2–4 vials over 2–3 sessions
- Radiesse: $900 / syringe — Per syringe; face or hands
- Hyperdilute Radiesse: $800 / syringe — Diluted for skin tightening & collagen stimulation; neck, décolleté, arms, knees

### Other Injectables
- Kybella — Double Chin: $650 / vial — Per vial; most clients need 2–4 sessions of 1–3 vials
- Hyaluronidase: $300 / vial — Enzyme that dissolves unwanted or misplaced hyaluronic acid filler — per vial; most clients need 2+ vials

Notes: A provider consultation is required prior to any treatment. All injectable pricing is per unit or per syringe/vial as noted. Unit totals vary based on individual anatomy, treatment area, and desired outcome and will be determined during your consultation.

### Package terms

- Eligibility and payment: All packages require an initial provider consultation and any applicable clinical assessment. A provider may decline or modify a package based on medical history, contraindications, or clinical judgment, including during the series. Treatment-specific consent is required before the first session. Packages can be paid in full at purchase or on a payment plan offered at Radiance's discretion; payment must be complete before the final session. A purchased package's price is locked in; future purchase prices may change.
- Validity and scheduling: Unless a different term is specified in writing at sale, packages are valid for 18 months from purchase. Unused sessions expire and are non-refundable except for an approved medical exception. Sessions must follow provider-recommended clinical spacing; clients should book ahead. Radiance will make reasonable efforts to remind clients of approaching expiry, but scheduling within the validity period is the client's responsibility.
- Cancellations and missed visits: A card must be kept on file. Give at least 48 hours' notice to cancel or reschedule a package appointment. Cancellations or rescheduling within 48 hours forfeit the session's deposit or hold and require a new deposit to reschedule. No-shows and late cancellations forfeit the session's hold and may count as a used session at Radiance's discretion. Management may consider documented medical or emergency circumstances.
- Refunds: Before any session is used, cancellation qualifies for a refund of amounts paid minus a 10% administrative/processing fee. Once the first session has occurred, packages are non-refundable except as required by Pennsylvania law or under an approved medical exception. For an approved partial refund, used sessions are deducted at then-current single-session prices, not discounted package rates. Packages have no cash value and cannot be exchanged for unrelated services or retail.
- Medical pauses: For pregnancy, a documented medical condition, or treatment that a Radiance provider determines is medically contraindicated to continue, request a pause in writing before the original expiry date. Approved pauses extend validity by the documented interruption, up to 12 additional months.
- Transfers and treatment changes: Packages belong to the purchaser. Unused sessions may be transferred once to a spouse, parent, child, or sibling with written request and management approval. Treatment types cannot be substituted or split; requests for credit toward a different package are considered individually and may involve price adjustments.
- VIP and promotions: All VIP tiers receive package pricing at 20% off regular single-session totals; tier discounts do not stack. Package pricing cannot be combined with other promotions or coupons unless expressly allowed. Cancelling VIP does not shorten an already-purchased package's validity, and cancelling a package does not change VIP status.
- Practice changes and amendments: If Radiance closes, it may offer a refund of unused balance calculated under the refund terms or a comparable provider referral/credit arrangement. A departing provider's remaining sessions are honored by another qualified Radiance provider. Terms in force at purchase govern that package; later changes are not retroactive unless required by law or more favorable to the client. Questions: contact@radiancepa.com.
